tools.name: register_contact
tools.description:
Register a new contact with an email, homepage, and signup timestamp.

    Use this tool when the user wants to add someone to a contact list or CRM
    and provides their email address, personal or company website, and a
    signup or join date. Typical phrases: "add jane@example.com as a contact",
    "register a new signup", "log this new lead".

    Args:
        email: RFC 5322 email
        homepage: Homepage URL
        signup_at: ISO-8601 datetime of signup

email.description: Contact's email address in RFC 5322 form
email.title: Email

signup_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the contact signed up (e.g. '2026-07-26T14:00:00Z')
signup_at.title: Signup At

tools.name: create_user_profile
tools.description:
Create a new user profile with a validated username, age, and interest tags.

    Use this tool when the user asks to create, register, or set up a new
    user account/profile and gives you a proposed username, their age, and
    a list of interests, hobbies, or topic tags. Typical phrases: "sign me
    up as user 'adharsh'", "create a profile for a 30 year old interested
    in hiking and coffee".

    Args:
        username: Alphanumeric/underscore, 3-32 chars
        age: 0-150
        tags: 1-10 interest tags

age.description: Age in whole years, between 0 and 150
age.title: Age

tags.description: Between 1 and 10 interest tags to associate with the profile
tags.title: Tags

tools.name: place_order
tools.description:
Place an order with separate billing and shipping addresses.

    Use this tool when the user wants to place, submit, or check out an
    order and specifies BOTH a billing address (for payment) and a
    shipping address (for delivery). If only one address is given, the
    caller should confirm before invoking this tool.

    Args:
        billing: Billing address
        shipping: Shipping address

Address.description: A postal address (referenced twice below to force a $ref/$defs entry).
Address.title: Address

billing.description: Address the order should be billed to

shipping.description: Address the order should be shipped to

tools.name: run_health_check
tools.description:
Run a health check on a service and report its state.

    Use this tool when the user wants to check whether a service is up, healthy,
    or degraded — "is the API healthy", "check the status of billing", "run a
    health check on search".

    Scenario: isolated ENUM on the OUTPUT side — the structured result's `state`
    field is a closed set of three literal values, producing an `enum` keyword
    in the output schema with no other output-side gaps.

    Args:
        service: Name of the service to check

service.description: Name of the service to health-check
service.title: Service

outputSchema.description: Health-check result carrying an enum state (isolated ENUM-on-output gap).

service.description: Name of the service that was checked
service.title: Service

state.description: Health state — one of healthy, degraded, or down
state.title: State

outputSchema.title: HealthReport
